item.title: Outside Forward
item.description: You play the left or right wing. Your side is always your side. Inside (wall side) and openside (open-pool side) swap as the puck moves, but you stay on your half of the pool. Your partner is the wing back on your side. For spacing and area diagrams, see Forwards in the 3-3. Offense With the puck Score first. If you can’t score, draw defenders so a teammate has a shot.

item.title: Center Forward (Pivot)
item.description: You play the middle. Go to the puck. Keep the attack moving — pass to the wings, drop on drives, or link with the wing backs when the play needs to shift. For the center forward’s area and spacing, see Forwards in the 3-3. Offense With the puck Pass to whoever has the better shot. If no pass, shoot. Don’t curl. Stay between the wing forwards — don’t swim outside them.
